components.text: The [color=yellow]Gravity Manipulator[color] is a machine that can be used to manipulate gravity in a specific chunk. It is commonly used in space stations and other structures to create a comfortable environment for inhabitants.

[br] [br] How to use : [br] Place the Gravity Manipulator in the desired chunk. Connect the machine to a power source, then open the GUI to select the desired gravity level. The machine will then adjust the gravity in the chunk accordingly.
